0.long_answer: Oculofaciocardiodental (OFCD) syndrome is caused by mutations in the BCOR gene. The same gene is also implicated in Lenz microphthalmia syndrome, which is an X‑linked recessive condition. While OFCD syndrome is typically seen in females due to its X‑linked dominant inheritance with male lethality, Lenz microphthalmia syndrome is inherited in an X‑linked recessive manner and primarily affects males.
